messages:
Ana Torres: Quick sync — legal wants a 2-week heads up for v1 API sunset. Planning to post deprecation notice next Tue 10am PT. Need docs action items: migration guide checklist, sample SDK snippets for TS/Python, model swap notes, and redirect links. Who can own what?
Matt Kim: I can own the migration checklist + PR description. Will add step-by-step callouts for model swap fallbacks.
Jess Patel: I'll update SDK snippets (TS + Py). Will convert existing examples to v2 + add compatibility shim example. ETA EOD Friday.
Samir O'Neill: I'll audit any code samples in guides for auth param rename and streaming changes. Also will run smoke tests.
Lucy Chen: I'll handle redirects and make sure old /v1 links keep a friendly message. Can we have a canonical redirect map?
Ana Torres: Yes — Matt, add a 'redirects.json' section in checklist. Docs-Bot: Reminder: please add 'docs' label to PRs. :robot_face:
Matt Kim: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — checklist + redirects stub. Please add review.
Jess Patel: Pushed TS + Py snippets to that PR. Note: auth param rename example:
```
// v1
client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
// v2
const client = new Redwood.Client({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })
```
Samir O'Neill: Found 3 more legacy examples in 'guides/embeddings' that reference old model name 'embed-128'. I'll open small PRs to update aliases.
Lucy Chen: Backend will serve 302 -> /docs/migration for now. Ops ask for list of affected anchors. I'll export today.
Matt Kim: Can someone add a one-liner rollback strategy in the checklist? If v2 rollout causes breakage we should auto-fallback to 'redwood-compat-small' model alias.
Ana Torres: Good call. Add canary gating and monitoring hooks. Need to coordinate with eng-sre for alert thresholds.
Samir O'Neill: I'll add a smoke test script snippet in the PR:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-small","input":"smoke test"}'
```
Docs-Bot: FYI — meeting set: #docs-review Tue 9am PT to final signoff. :calendar:
Jess Patel: Will add a short migration FAQ section covering embed dim change and SDK param rename.
Lucy Chen: Once PRs merge I'll submit the redirect map to infra and confirm 302 behavior.
Matt Kim: Thanks team. If anyone hits blocking behavior in snippets ping me and I'll pause the deprecation announcement.
Ana Torres: Thanks — cross-posting to #product and #eng-sre after signoff. :pray:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2025-03-18 18:00 UTC (docs site).
